title: A reviewed increment supports learning
description: One bounded clinical question links explicit meaning, computable content, and evaluated local use. Findings can return to clinical, artifact, or implementation owners; the loop does not automatically create new evidence or approve a change.

nodes.label: Clinical question
nodes.body: Source, scope, intended action and examples

nodes.label: Evaluated use
nodes.body: Local integration, monitoring, effects and limits

notes.text: Return findings to the responsible reviewer. Revalidate affected products when meaning or dependencies change.
Conceptual cycle: solid arrows = work products; dashed arrow = review and revision, not automatic learning.
